note: Historical settings, paired with the HC costume cards. Each place is an original generic site of one period and region, never a copy of a real one; no places of worship, altars or religious images; pre-modern scenes are lit only by daylight, candles, oil lamps or lanterns (gas lamps from the Victorian parlour on). Every desc names the far wall, both sides and an empty centre about four metres from the camera, and checks carry the structural period markers QC judges against.
